Toma como referencia a quien está primer: Uses whoever is first in the on-screen order (%@) as reference.
Toma el segundo más quieto de cada perso: Takes each person's quietest second as the “fingerprint” of their room noise and lowers whatever doesn't exceed it. Good for constant noise (air conditioning, fan, hum) and doesn't touch the voice. Different from “Studio sound”: it uses no artificial intelligence and can be used alongside or instead.
Toma un segundo del ambiente propio de c: Takes a second of each person's own ambience (their room's air) and places it where their track has nothing: before they start recording, after they finish and under the bleeps. And it smooths every cut joint so it doesn't click. That way cuts don't sound “dead”.
